added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest declares no baseline_suite and no after_suite arm (both keys present but empty), so no baseline/after gate-log pair exists to difference; its own gates are single-arm logs (base-part-cli.log EXIT=2, part-coverage.log EXIT=0, comparison-budget-retry.log EXIT=0, output-record.log EXIT=0) and no test file is added (tests []).

0.reason: The gate log is right and the fragment's prose miscounts: name 231 in 57, 58, 58, 58 and docs 232 in four parts of 58. The plan record and every piece brief use the log's figures.

findings.text: follow-on: the landing fragment states the four-part dry check "covered all 231 non-excluded names and all 231 non-excluded documentation items ... Each axis split into 57, 58, 58 and 58 items", but the recorded gate log part-coverage.log reports "name: 231 non-excluded items; four part sizes [57, 58, 58, 58]" and "docs: 232 non-excluded items; four part sizes [58, 58, 58, 58]"; the sole cohort exclusion (x_direction_unit_vector_of_camera) is a name-axis item, so names are 231 and docs 232. The fragment under-counts the docs axis by one and misstates its slice sizes, and the manifest's artifacts line repeats the error, so a coordinator reading the landing record carries a wrong coverage figure for the docs axis.

follow-on: check_comparison_budget raises RuntimeError for any JSON in srtj-cohort/ that lacks piece_spend_total_usd, but main() writes its initial status:"running" record at line 829 before that key is set, so a piece interrupted between line 829 and the finally-save (which sets the key) leaves a JSON the guard refuses on the next invocation; the refusal is a hard stop ("piece has no spend total") rather than a reservation or a skip, so a single torn write can block every remaining piece of the comparison.

follow-on: the manifest declares three write paths (srtj-cohort-run.py, srtj-cohort-piece-limits.html and docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-cohort-piece-limits), but the reviewed brief's Write scope (brief.md:38-40) names only srtj-cohort-run.py, and the brief's done-when says "no other file is touched" while the diff adds the html fragment; the html is mandated by the appended working rules' landing-record clause, so the brief and its own working rules disagree, and the docs/figures/... path is declared but never written by any commit.
